definitions: An arrangement to have something (such as a room, table, or seat) held for one's use at a future time.
A qualification to an agreement or statement, often indicating doubt or disagreement.
An area of land set aside for a specific purpose, especially for indigenous peoples.
examples: I made a reservation for dinner.
He expressed some reservations about the plan.
The tribe lives on the reservation.
The reservation of the right to appeal.
